_comment: Read by scripts/security/audit-gate.cjs (#1340). Each entry excuses ONE advisory in ONE package scope until `expires`; on that date the gate fails until someone re-checks it and either fixes the dependency or renews the entry with a current reason. Keep expiries within ~3 months.

exceptions.reason: No zod 3.x release is patched; @scalar/types 0.1.7 requires zod ^3.23.8. It validates the OpenAPI document we generate, not request bodies. openai only peers on zod and accepts ^4, so this clears once the swagger plugin moves to zod 4 or is replaced.

@prisma/config 6.19.3 pins deepmerge-ts 7.1.5 exactly; the fix is the 8.x major. It merges Prisma's own config objects when the CLI/client loads, so there is no recursive object graph from outside. Clears with the Prisma upgrade.
